metadata.author: Senior CAO Scientific Benchmark / Data Governance Auditor
metadata.governance_mandate: Strict audit of external datasets for look-alike and non-oil scientific evaluation. EXP-07 model training, threshold search, fine-tuning, and model modification are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Part-I is frozen, Part-III is permanently quarantined under Rule 38, and DARTIS proxies remain semantically unresolved.

evaluation_units_defined.PIXEL: Individual 10m x 10m or 100m x 100m spatial resolution cell. Used strictly for spatial overlap (IoU, Dice, confusion matrix).
evaluation_units_defined.PATCH: Fixed sub-image crop (e.g. 256x256 at 100m, or 512x512 at 10m). Must be evaluated with clustered variance.
evaluation_units_defined.SCENE: Full-frame SAR acquisition vignette (e.g. 20 km x 20 km Wave Mode vignette).
evaluation_units_defined.PARENT_PRODUCT: Single unique Sentinel-1 SAFE observation granule (~250 km x 200 km). The primary independent sampling unit.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 Typical Oceanic and Atmospheric Phenomena Semantic Segmentation Dataset
datasets.source_citation: Li, Q., Bai, X., Hu, L., Li, L., Bao, Y., Geng, X., & Yan, X.-H. (2025). Semantic Segmentation of Typical Oceanic and Atmospheric Phenomena in SAR Images Based on Modified Segformer. Remote Sensing, 18(1), 113. https://doi.org/10.3390/rs18010113; ESSD Preprint: https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2024-222.
datasets.sensor: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR (Sentinel-1A: 5,002 slices, Sentinel-1B: 9 slices)
datasets.polarization: VV only (100% of distributed slices are single-pol VV; 0 VH channels exist)
datasets.resolution: 100 m (downsampled by 10x from native 10m Sentinel-1 GRD)
datasets.dimensions: 256 x 256 pixels (coverage footprint: 25.6 km x 25.6 km)
datasets.physical_representation: Scaled unsigned 16-bit integers (uint16, range [0, 65535]). Preprocessed via internal pipeline: Radiometric Calibrate -> Down-sample -> Sea-Land Mask -> Re-calibration -> Normalization. Not distributed as physical float32 sigma0 or decibels (dB). Georeferencing is stored as 4 corner tiepoints in GeoTIFF Tag 33922 (ModelTiepointTag); CRS tag is None.
label_classes: HM: Artificial Objects / Vessels / Wind Turbines (Index 13)
OS: Mineral Oil Spill (Index 14, currently insufficient data according to authors)
datasets.label_type: Pixel-level multi-class semantic segmentation masks (256x256 uint8 PNG)
datasets.label_provenance: Manual polygon annotation using Labelme software by physical oceanography researchers. Referenced multi-sensor physical context (MODIS/VIIRS SST, IMERG GPM rainfall, ERA5 wind fields, and wave dispersion dynamics). Slices are palette-indexed PNG masks (mode 'P', uint8).
datasets.annotation_method: Manual polygon annotation via Labelme referencing multi-sensor oceanographic physics
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: High-quality manual expert annotations of physical phenomena confirmed via multi-sensor synoptics.
datasets.parent_product_identity: 484 unique Sentinel-1 IW source scenes (averaging 5.43 slices per scene, range 1-51) + 2,383 independent Sentinel-1 Wave Mode (WV) vignettes. Source scene filenames follow ESA naming: s1a-iw-grd-vv-<start>-<stop>-<orbit>-<take>-001-<slice>.
datasets.geography: Global oceans: Western Pacific, South China Sea, Mediterranean, Malacca/Singapore Strait, North Atlantic, polar marginal seas.
datasets.independence: Independent research group and purpose. 0 product overlap with DARTIS Eastern Mediterranean 2019 survey. 0 direct overlap with Trujillo Part III quarantined set. Geographic overlap with general maritime basins requires parent-product level screening before holdout creation.
datasets.independence_from_part_i: Independent global research collection; orthogonal to petroleum spill dataset.
datasets.independence_from_part_iii: Strictly independent (0 shared product IDs with quarantined Part III).
datasets.independence_from_dartis: Strictly independent (0 shared product IDs with DARTIS 2019 Levantine survey).
datasets.source_data_lineage: Derived synthesis incorporating: (1) 2,383 WV vignettes from TenGeoP-SARwv (Wang et al. 2019, SEANOE); (2) 156 IW scenes from Tao et al. 2022 internal wave detection dataset (figshare); (3) 328 additional Sentinel-1 IW scenes curated by authors.
datasets.leakage_status: CLEAN relative to DARTIS (0 shared products). CLEAN relative to Part III (0 shared products). Internal split has parent-scene leakage (random 8:1:1 patch splitting); future specialist training must re-split by parent scene.
datasets.reproducibility: Fully reproducible: public Zenodo API download, checksum verified (MD5: 5bf6e338dd2a686de5ecd5fee3e139cd).
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: METHODOLOGICALLY USEFUL BUT NOT DIRECTLY SUITABLE FOR ZERO-SHOT EXP-06 EVALUATION
datasets.phenomenon_specialist_suitability: EXCELLENT (Primary candidate for training and evaluating an Ocean Phenomena Specialist model)
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: EXCELLENT for BS, LWA, IW, OF (4 distinct look-alike classes with dense pixel segmentation masks)
datasets.evaluation_suitability: SUITABLE as a Benchmark for Specialist Models (Benchmark A). NOT SUITABLE for direct evaluation of EXP-06 (Benchmark B) without re-acquiring native 10m L1 GRD source products.
datasets.training_suitability: SUITABLE FOR FUTURE SPECIALIST TRAINING ONLY (Strictly barred from EXP-07 training)
datasets.confidence: VERY HIGH (Directly verified from byte-level archive headers, Zenodo API, and published journal paper)
datasets.recommendation: QUALIFIED FOR SPECIALIST PROTOCOL (Tier-1 Look-alike & Phenomenon Benchmark)
datasets.rejection_reason: NOT REJECTED. Qualified as Tier-1 Phenomenon Resource; zero-shot evaluation on EXP-06 blocked due to physical scale/channel mismatch.

datasets.name: Refined Deep-SAR Oil Spill (SOS) Dataset
datasets.source_citation: Zuenko, D., & Khaidarova, I. (2025); Zhu, Q. et al. (2021). IEEE TGRS, 60, 1-13. https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2021.3115492.
datasets.physical_representation: 8-bit grayscale PNG / uint8 normalized intensity. Lacks calibrated float32 sigma0 dB.
datasets.label_provenance: Manual and semi-automated polygonal segmentation from earlier SAR oil collections.
datasets.annotation_method: Semi-automated polygonal segmentation from historical oil spill repositories
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Annotated interpretations; high uncertainty on look-alike physical mechanism.
datasets.parent_product_identity: Subset of historical Sentinel-1 scenes from 2015-2020.
datasets.geography: Global coastal and marine shipping routes (Middle East, Mediterranean, East Asia).
datasets.independence: QUESTIONABLE (Shares parent scenes with open-access oil spill archives that formed Trujillo 2024 Part I and Part III).
datasets.independence_from_part_i: POTENTIAL OVERLAP (Shares historical Sentinel-1 oil spill scenes with Trujillo Part I).
datasets.independence_from_part_iii: HIGH LEAKAGE RISK (May share underlying ESA acquisitions with Part III).
datasets.independence_from_dartis: Independent (distinct geographic focus from DARTIS Eastern Mediterranean 2019 survey).
datasets.source_data_lineage: Direct refinement of Zhu et al. (2021) Deep-SAR Oil Spill dataset.
datasets.leakage_status: HIGH LEAKAGE RISK against Trujillo Part I and quarantined Part III. Requires exhaustive product ID audit.
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: NOT DIRECTLY COMPATIBLE (uint8 representation, 1280x1280 dimensions, VV-only single pol).
datasets.phenomenon_specialist_suitability: MODERATE (Lacks specific phenomenon breakdown; bundles all lookalikes into one generic class).
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: MODERATE (Generic look-alike label lacks physical mechanism distinction).
datasets.evaluation_suitability: CONDITIONALLY QUALIFIED pending parent-scene leakage firewall clearance.
datasets.confidence: HIGH (Dataset identified and inspected, leakage risk confirmed).
datasets.recommendation: CONDITIONALLY QUALIFIED (Requires strict parent-scene leakage screening against Trujillo Part I and Part III)
datasets.rejection_reason: High risk of parent-scene leakage against Trujillo training and validation partitions; lacks phenomenon-specific labels.

datasets.name: DARTIS 2019 Eastern Mediterranean Candidate Population
datasets.source_citation: Yang, L., & Singha, S. (2025). PANGAEA. https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.980773.
datasets.physical_representation: Level-1 GRD calibrated sigma0 float32 decibels.
label_classes: No-oil coastal / open water dark feature candidates (unresolved)
datasets.label_type: Provisional bounding box / crop candidate coordinates without pixel-level ground truth
datasets.label_provenance: Absence of reported oil spills in 2019 Eastern Mediterranean survey. Lacks per-pixel ground truth.
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Survey catalog absence-of-reported-oil; NOT confirmed negative ground truth.
datasets.parent_product_identity: 343 target parent Sentinel-1 products (325 represented in 517 valid candidates).
datasets.independence: INDEPENDENT FROM TRUJILLO (Eastern Mediterranean 2019 survey, no overlap with Part I or Part III).
datasets.independence_from_part_i: Strictly independent (0 shared products with Trujillo Part I).
datasets.independence_from_part_iii: Strictly independent (0 shared products with quarantined Part III).
datasets.source_data_lineage: Copernicus Sentinel Hub Process API acquisition from original DARTIS catalogue.
datasets.leakage_status: CLEAN relative to Trujillo Part I and Part III. Current internal proxy dataset.
datasets.reproducibility: Fully reproducible via project ingestion pipeline.
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: COMPATIBLE WITH CANONICAL NORMALIZATION (Dual-pol float32 dB).
datasets.phenomenon_specialist_suitability: LOW (Lacks physical phenomenon labels; status remains unresolved).
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: LOW (Absence of oil does not provide validated look-alike mask).
datasets.evaluation_suitability: RETAINED STRICTLY AS PROVISIONAL PROXY DIAGNOSTIC (Rule 39/40; cannot serve as official false-alarm rate denominator).
datasets.confidence: VERY HIGH (Physically validated in Phase 7A.2; semantically adjudicated in Phase 7A.3).
datasets.recommendation: RETAINED AS UNRESOLVED PROXY POPULATION (Frozen under Rule 39/40; diagnostic only)
datasets.rejection_reason: Lacks verified negative ground truth; candidate dark features remain semantically unresolved.

datasets.name: TenGeoP-SARwv Geophysical Phenomena Dataset
datasets.source_citation: Wang, C. et al. (2019, 2022). Geoscience Data Journal, 6, 105-115; Remote Sensing of Environment, 234, 111457.
datasets.dimensions: 20 km x 20 km vignettes (approx 4000 x 4000 pixels)
label_classes: 10 geophysical phenomena (Pure Ocean Wave, Wind Streak, Micro Convective Cells, Rain Cells, etc.)
datasets.label_type: Scene-level categorical classification (single label per vignette)
datasets.label_provenance: Scene-level classification labels (single label per vignette).
datasets.annotation_method: Expert visual inspection and meteorological cross-referencing
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Scene-level categorical label; lacks pixel-level segmentation boundaries.
datasets.parent_product_identity: Global Sentinel-1 Wave Mode acquisitions from 2016.
datasets.independence_from_part_i: Independent (open ocean Wave Mode vs coastal IW oil scenes).
datasets.source_data_lineage: Ifremer / ESA Sentinel-1 Wave Mode collection.
datasets.leakage_status: CLEAN relative to coastal IW datasets.
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: INCOMPATIBLE SENSOR GEOMETRY (Wave Mode vignettes, steep incidence angle, single-pol VV).
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: MODERATE (Scene-level labels only, no segmentation masks).
datasets.confidence: VERY HIGH (Directly cited as upstream source for Li et al.).
datasets.recommendation: REFERENCE TAXONOMY ONLY (Wave Mode sensor geometry incompatible with Sentinel-1 IW oil detection)
datasets.rejection_reason: Sensor geometry mismatch (Wave Mode vs IW); lacks pixel-level segmentation masks.

datasets.name: NASA JPL UAVSAR Polarimetric Benchmark
datasets.source_citation: Jones, C. E. et al. (2012-2024). NASA JPL / Alaska Satellite Facility DAAC.
datasets.polarization: HH, HV, VH, VV fully polarimetric scattering matrix
datasets.label_type: Pixel-level polarimetric parameter maps and segmented regions
datasets.label_provenance: In situ shipboard sampling and aerial optical validation during Deepwater Horizon / Macondo.
datasets.annotation_method: Multi-instrument in situ aerial and sea-surface sampling
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Physically verified ground truth (in situ boat sampling and physical oil recovery).
datasets.independence_from_dartis: Strictly independent (Gulf of Mexico vs Mediterranean).
datasets.leakage_status: ZERO LEAKAGE (Different sensor, platform, frequency, and flight lines).
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: INCOMPATIBLE PHYSICAL SENSOR (Airborne L-band quad-pol vs Spaceborne C-band dual-pol).
datasets.phenomenon_specialist_suitability: HIGH for theoretical polarimetric decomposition research.
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: HIGH for polarimetric physics, but not transferable to C-band dual-pol.
datasets.confidence: VERY HIGH (Gold standard polarimetric truth, but wrong sensor domain).
datasets.recommendation: THEORETICAL REFERENCE ONLY (Airborne L-band quad-polarization is methodologically distinct)
datasets.rejection_reason: Airborne L-band quad-polarization cannot directly evaluate spaceborne C-band dual-polarization model.

datasets.name: Ramirez Gulf of Mexico Sentinel-1 Dataset
datasets.source_citation: Ramirez, E. et al. (2021). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4672426.
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Weakly delineated polygons; lacks negative or look-alike classes.
datasets.independence_from_part_i: Geographic proximity to Trujillo Gulf of Mexico subset.
datasets.independence_from_part_iii: Unknown overlap with Part III seeps.
datasets.leakage_status: Geographic proximity to Trujillo Gulf of Mexico subset.
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: NOT COMPATIBLE (8-bit PNG, VV-only, small sample count).
datasets.phenomenon_specialist_suitability: NONE (No look-alike or oceanic phenomena labels).
datasets.recommendation: REJECTED (Insufficient sample count N=23; no look-alike or negative classes)
datasets.rejection_reason: Extremely small sample size (N=23); lacks look-alike or non-oil classes entirely.

datasets.name: EMSA CleanSeaNet Operational Spill & Lookalike Archive
datasets.source_citation: European Maritime Safety Agency (EMSA). CleanSeaNet Service (2015-2024).
datasets.physical_representation: Operational radar deliverables and coast guard feedback reports.
datasets.label_type: Operational detection alerts and patrol craft in situ verification reports
datasets.label_provenance: Coast guard patrol aircraft and vessel in situ feedback.
datasets.annotation_method: Operational operator verification and airborne maritime patrol feedback
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: Operational coast guard in situ verification reports.
datasets.licensing: Restricted / Proprietary (EU coastal state authorities only).
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: OPERATIONAL RADAR PRODUCTS (Directly compatible SAR, but access barred).
datasets.recommendation: REJECTED (Access restricted to EU coastal state authorities; non-reproducible)
datasets.rejection_reason: Closed repository; restricted to EU member-state coast guard authorities; non-reproducible.

datasets.name: MARIDA Marine Debris and Natural Slicks Dataset
datasets.source_citation: Kikaki, K. et al. (2022). ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, 188, 330-354.
datasets.label_type: Pixel-level optical semantic segmentation masks (256x256 uint8)
datasets.label_provenance: Expert manual annotation based on spectral indices (NDWI, FAI).
datasets.annotation_method: Manual annotation based on optical spectral indices (NDWI, FAI)
datasets.annotation_vs_ground_truth: High-confidence optical spectral annotations; zero radar physics.
datasets.exp06_direct_compatibility: FUNDAMENTALLY INCOMPATIBLE SENSOR (Optical multispectral vs Radar backscatter).
datasets.lookalike_specialist_suitability: LOW for SAR (Cannot evaluate SAR radar backscatter).
datasets.recommendation: REJECTED FOR SAR BENCHMARK (Optical sensor modality is incompatible with SAR backscatter)
datasets.rejection_reason: Optical sensor modality (Sentinel-2 MSI reflectance); fundamentally incompatible with SAR backscatter.
